notes: Passive Location Tracker module is live. Watches GPS in the foreground, buffers pings (flushes to Supabase every 3 min), detects dwells (60+ min within 50m radius by default), inserts detected_locations row + pings a toast/notification. Auto-starts on boot if Settings → Passive Location Tracking is ON. PWA-only (foreground) for now; Capacitor background geolocation plugs into this same module later. Answer to 'can it track when app is closed like Rewind?': not in the browser — needs the native iOS build. Integrated approach chosen (build into BM), with a lean 'BM Crew' sibling app noted for Phase 2 once crew comes online.
